scope: Current repository declarations, source usage, Dockerfiles and complete Cargo/npm lockfile inventories. This is not an installed-runtime SBOM or a dependency vulnerability audit. Development, optional and platform-specific lock entries are included. OS package trees and dependencies of separately installed build tools are outside the lockfile inventory.

architecture.frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite; frontend is not rewritten in Rust/WASM
architecture.calculation_engine: Custom Rust implementations in engine.rs, strategy.rs, metrics.rs and schedule.rs; no separate backtesting or technical-analysis crate is declared
architecture.ui_components: shadcn/ui-style components stored as source, based on Radix UI; no shadcn runtime npm dependency
architecture.api_schema: Static OpenAPI JSON exposed by Axum; no separate OpenAPI generation or Swagger UI crate declared
